[package]
name = "notes"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"

[dependencies]
anyhow = "1.0.105"
axum = "0.8.9"
form_urlencoded = "1.2.3"
rusqlite = { version = "0.43.0", features = ["bundled"] }
serde = { version = "1.0.229", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0.154"
tokio = { version = "1.54.1", features = ["rt-multi-thread", "macros", "net", "signal"] }

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
cargo build --release --locked
cp target/release/notes ./app
